conditions.runtime: JEM Building, Building But Better, Handcrafted and JEM Compat are installed; a player uses jem_building:builder_hammer on a block supported by either external native hammer contract.

change.summary: Use the JEM Builder Hammer for JEM Building, native BBB and native Handcrafted hammer interactions.

modifiers.before: The BBB hammer, Handcrafted hammer and standalone JEM Builder Hammer are separate player-facing items.
modifiers.after: Using jem_building:builder_hammer first calls Handcrafted's native Hammerable action when applicable, otherwise BBB consumes the same item through its native bbb:hammers tag, otherwise JEM Building retains its own construction interaction. One click never executes multiple hammer owners.

modifiers.before: The Handcrafted hammer has a craft recipe, JEI catalog entry, quest references and a JEM trade listing.
modifiers.after: New Handcrafted-hammer crafting, creative-tab and curated JEI display, authored quest rewards and JEM trade listing are removed in favor of jem_building:builder_hammer. The old registered item remains loadable for compatibility but Item Obliterator removes player-held copies.

modifiers.before: BBB exposes its hammer through recipe, creative, JEI, quest reward and JEM market acquisition.
modifiers.after: BBB's original hammer is removed from new acquisition and presentation in favor of jem_building:builder_hammer. Its registered ID remains loadable for compatibility but Item Obliterator removes player-held copies.

cause.owner: JEMCompat Handcrafted adapter and JEM-authored acquisition data

rationale.purpose: Give players one JEM Builder Hammer for all three construction systems without replacing either installed mod's block implementation.
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly promoted the JEM Building hammer to the only player-facing hammer and required Item Obliterator retirement of the Handcrafted and BBB items. Codex inspected exact installed Handcrafted 3.0.6 Hammerable bytecode and BBB 2.0pre4 tag-driven behavior, then selected native interface and tag adapters.

introduced.summary: Route Handcrafted's native hammerable action through bbb:hammer and retire new Handcrafted-hammer acquisition.

history.summary: Promote jem_building:builder_hammer to the single item, preserve native Handcrafted and BBB actions, and retire both legacy hammers through recipe, creative, JEI, quest, market and Item Obliterator ownership.
Keep both installed mods and old save item IDs while assigning new acquisition and interactions to the existing BBB hammer.
Remove the legacy Handcrafted hammer from creative tabs and authored acquisition, while moving the furniture quest reward to the BBB hammer.

relations: Legacy handcrafted:hammer and bbb:hammer remain registered but are denied by Item Obliterator
notes: The adapter activates the JEM item only when JEM Building is installed and adds no runtime library or rewritten external block behavior.
unresolved: Player interaction with installed Handcrafted and BBB blocks remains unobserved because the user prohibited runtime tests and client launch.
